lod_sheet: 3d/renders/lod/oke_bucket/sheet.jpg (phone-lod2-lod3.jpg not present; phone panel taken from sheet)
fixes: Stave count: canonical shows about 16 wide staves; concept #1 in sheet-vs-bath-props.png shows about 30 narrow staves. Target 28-32 staves at LOD0 with a 1.5 mm V-groove between staves, not a single dark line.
Rim: top edge is a thin bevel. Concept rims are thick. Add a rolled top lip 15-20 mm tall, outward 6-8 mm from the wall, so the rim catches light as a band.

Ladle scoop: canonical scoop is a flat disc about 15 mm deep and reads as a paddle. Concept scoop is a deep cup. Target scoop bowl 0.12 m across and 0.05-0.06 m deep, handle 0.55 m long, 30 mm dia tapering to 20 mm at the tip.
Water line: the interior reads as a pale cream disc at rim height. Lower the water surface 0.06 m below the rim so the inner wall shows, and use a dark glossy surface so it reads as water.

Bowl: with_ladle default has no bowl in canonical; concept shows a shallow glazed bowl beside the bucket. Add the bowl (r 0.09 m, depth 0.04 m) to with_ladle and make sure it is in the canonical beauty view. Ceramic is not in the library (see library_issues).
library_issues: bronze: hoops render as crumpled, noisy bump texture in canonical and go near-black at LOD1-2 in the sheet. Needs a smoother bronze/copper with lower bump and a stable mid-tone at distance.
ceramic (NEW in asset_list) is not in the library; the bowl is built as lacquer_dark, so it renders black where the concept has teal glaze.
Water surface: no water material on the disc; a dark wet surface slot would fix the pale-disc read.
summary: Recognisable as a hinoki bucket with bronze hoops and a long ladle, but staves are too wide and few, the rim is thin, the ladle reads as a paddle, the hoop material looks crumpled and goes black at LOD1-2, and the LOD2/LOD3 silhouettes are a few pixels at phone scale. Seeds look nearly identical in the sheet.
